root_cause: Missing/insufficient bounds validation on an attacker-controlled `size` (and the related `space` field) before it is used in unsigned arithmetic (subtraction that can underflow) and in a size-plus-constant allocation (addition that can overflow), both feeding directly into memory allocation and copy operations.
findings: get_packet_lj92() takes a 64-bit `size` value that is derived, in read_packet(), from an unsigned 32-bit value read straight from the MLV file (block size minus a few fixed header fields and an attacker-controlled `space` field).
